deviations.what: t2's Discord who-filter changes after review: users and roles combine as EITHER (a listed user or anyone holding a listed role), not both; a bare-string channels/users/roles value (other than channels "all") is a one-item list instead of no filter; a users filter never admits an event with no author id or name
deviations.reason: operator decision 2026-10-25 on the wave 1 Qwen review: q5 reads as listed users OR opt-in roles; two fail-open edges found in matching._discord_admits

deviations.what: server assignment changes: Culture.dev (actor discord-bot) listens in JetsonBot experiments (1413999242648748195) and the operator's private server; jetson-bot listens only in the public Jetson AI Lab Research Group (1326246312072581160), not in experiments. The spec's after-state 'two bots across both servers' becomes one bot per server set, three servers in all
deviations.reason: operator decision 2026-10-25 while setting the jetson-bot grants

deviations.what: t9 offers markdown.render in the workflow step panel (a Built-in select on code steps, filling its typed ports) instead of in ActionPicker: markdown.render is a code-step builtin, not an action kind, and no picker offered builtins before
deviations.reason: plan text assumed markdown.render was an action kind; the t9 agent found it is config.builtin on a code step

deviations.what: Posting in Jetson AI Lab is decided: jetson-bot posts each daily newspaper's headlines and section summaries (Discord-sized Markdown chunks) to channel 1405689195862818979 of the public server, through a live continuation rule on rules.run.succeeded of daily-newspaper; a new builtin newspaper.digest builds the chunks from the stored issue; ships with Release 1 as 0.30.0
deviations.reason: operator request 2026-10-25: send the daily newsletter to that channel, as a rule/extension, test once with today's issue; library.culture.dev is behind Cloudflare Access so a link alone would not open for public members

deviations.what: d4's posting flow is built from generic steps instead of a newspaper-specific builtin: run.read (a step's outputs from the verified upstream run) and markdown.from_html (HTML as Markdown chunks) replace newspaper.digest; the newspaper specifics (render step, classes to drop, the Discord channel) live only in the live flow's config
deviations.reason: operator rule 2026-10-25: the code shouldn't have the newsletter, that's configuration; code holds schedule, web search, passing data, previous run results, convert to Markdown, post to Discord

deviations.what: Discord items take the library kind discord-message (discord-react reserved for reactions), not document; culture-library must add the kind (culture-library#19), so the spec's 'culture-library unchanged' boundary no longer holds for kinds. Until it ships the live #spark-tests rule is disabled; the committed bundle and docs move from document to discord-message, and the bundle names its bot literally (an action step's actor is never a reference)
deviations.reason: operator 2026-10-25: 'It shouldn't be a document. It's a message, or discord (or discord-message, so we can add later discord-react)'; first live test also showed actor: inputs.actor cannot resolve

deltas.behavior_text: Each delivered daily newspaper is posted to the Jetson AI Lab Discord as Jetson Bot through a live continuation rule (rules.run.succeeded of daily-newspaper with an item_id) and generic steps run.read -> markdown.from_html -> discord.message for_each; live on 0.30.0 to #bot-experimentations 1407337283794767873 (workflow rev 2; #bot-news denies the bot Send Messages). Validated live 2026-10-25: run run-2c77aee79f2c472da6493d372d69876d posted the 2026-10-25 issue as 4 ordered messages (1741/1630/1862/1559 chars, no embeds; ids 1563940592843624479..1563940599151853709), read back from the channel; the operator confirmed it works
